SELECT clinical_event_data.value as treatment, patient.stable_id as patientId, cancer_study.cancer_study_identifier as studyId, clinical_event_derived.start_date as start, clinical_event_derived.stop_date as stop FROM clinical_event_derived INNER JOIN clinical_event_data ON clinical_event_derived.clinical_event_id = clinical_event_data.clinical_event_id INNER JOIN patient ON clinical_event_derived.patient_id = patient.internal_id INNER JOIN sample ON patient.internal_id = sample.patient_id INNER JOIN cancer_study ON patient.cancer_study_id = cancer_study.cancer_study_id
AND LOWER(clinical_event_derived.event_type) = LOWER('TREATMENT') AND LOWER(clinical_event_data.`key`) = LOWER(#{key})

SELECT sample.stable_id as sampleId, patient.stable_id as patientId, cancer_study.cancer_study_identifier as studyId, clinical_event_derived.start_date as timeTaken FROM clinical_event_derived INNER JOIN clinical_event_data ON clinical_event_derived.clinical_event_id = clinical_event_data.clinical_event_id INNER JOIN patient ON clinical_event_derived.patient_id = patient.internal_id INNER JOIN sample ON clinical_event_data.value = sample.stable_id INNER JOIN cancer_study ON patient.cancer_study_id = cancer_study.cancer_study_id
AND LOWER(clinical_event_data.`key`) = LOWER('SAMPLE_ID') AND (LOWER(clinical_event_derived.event_type) = LOWER('Sample Acquisition') OR LOWER(clinical_event_derived.event_type) = LOWER('SPECIMEN'))

SELECT sample.stable_id as sampleId, patient.stable_id as patientId, cancer_study.cancer_study_identifier as studyId FROM sample INNER JOIN patient ON sample.patient_id = patient.internal_id INNER JOIN cancer_study ON patient.cancer_study_id = cancer_study.cancer_study_id

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM clinical_event_derived INNER JOIN clinical_event_data ON clinical_event_derived.clinical_event_id = clinical_event_data.clinical_event_id INNER JOIN patient ON clinical_event_derived.patient_id = patient.internal_id INNER JOIN sample ON patient.internal_id = sample.patient_id INNER JOIN cancer_study ON patient.cancer_study_id = cancer_study.cancer_study_id
AND LOWER(clinical_event_derived.event_type) = LOWER('TREATMENT') AND LOWER(clinical_event_data.`key`) = LOWER(#{key}) LIMIT 1 )

AND LOWER(clinical_event_data.`key`) = LOWER('SAMPLE_ID') AND (LOWER(clinical_event_derived.event_type) = LOWER('Sample Acquisition') OR LOWER(clinical_event_derived.event_type) = LOWER('SPECIMEN')) LIMIT 1)
